title: HEALING GARDEN – Certosa Park – Design Contest
description: Design a buildable Healing Garden in Certosa Park, Turin, for biodiversity and well-being. Free and open to all.
descriptionDetailed: Non Architecture invites designs for a buildable Healing Garden within a 25,600 m² area of Parco della Certosa in Turin, the first of six contests in the European Sleeping Beauty project. The winner receives €7,500 to develop the design toward construction within a €60,000 budget. Proposals should support biodiversity and well-being.

prize.description: Winner (1st prize) receives €7,500 to further develop the project toward construction, which carries a €60,000 construction budget. 9 honorable mentions and up to 20 finalists are published on the Non-a contests website. Additional special prizes may be introduced during evaluation.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to all designers working individually or in teams
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to all human beings from every age and cultural background. Participants may work individually or in teams of up to 4 people. No registration fee applies.
